name: btn-creative-top
title: Top Slide Reveal Button
description: A pill-shaped Our Work link that starts white with black text. On hover a green fill slides up from the bottom edge to cover it, and the label turns white.
use: A portfolio or agency link should give a bright, obvious hover without adding an icon or second control.
avoid: The green fill and label are hardcoded, and the reveal is hover-only, so touch users never see the second state.
a11y: Built as a div with cursor-pointer, it cannot be tabbed to or activated from the keyboard and is not announced as a button. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white rounded pill with the words Our Work in bold black. On hover a bright green fill rises from the bottom until it covers the whole pill, and the label flips to white.
behaves: Hovering slides a green layer up inside the pill while the black label fades out and a white copy takes its place. The green stays clipped to the pill's curve, and leaving sends it back down.
customise: The label, white surface and green fill colour are hardcoded classes; it takes no props, so every change needs a file edit.
weight: light: A pill, one green layer and a pair of CSS transforms.
issues: The control is a div, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot activate it.
The description claims it turns rectangular on hover, but the outer pill clips the corners and the shape never changes.
polishWhy: Bright and clear hover, but it is a basic colour-fill swap with little extra craft.
